title: Independent computation of polarization in Zn/Co-doped BaTiO3
difficulty_reasons: The material and endpoint are fixed, while method selection, branch handling and validation design are open and must be justified.

paper.title: A first-principles study on the ferroelectric and optical properties of (Zn, Co)-doped barium titanate

data.description: Explicit BZCT and BTO structures plus deterministic identity and boundary specification.
